calibration_details.description: Base LogisticRegression pipeline refitted on all N=242 development records. Calibrator fitted on 4-fold out-of-fold decision function scores.

cohort_metadata.cohort_name: UCI Cleveland Heart Disease Benchmark Cohort
cohort_limitations: Single-center retrospective cohort from Cleveland Clinic Foundation (1988)
Small sample size (N=303 total; N=242 dev, N=61 holdout)
Non-invasive screening subset excludes fluoroscopy and scintigraphy
Informational risk estimation only; not an acute cardiac diagnostic tool

LOW.clinical_interpretation: Low estimated statistical probability; routine lifestyle counseling.

MODERATE.clinical_interpretation: Intermediate risk; review hemodynamic vitals and glycemic control.

HIGH.clinical_interpretation: Elevated statistical probability; clinician consultation recommended.

CRITICAL.clinical_interpretation: Substantial biomarker elevation; prioritize clinical cardiovascular review.

clinical_non_diagnostic_boundary.mandatory_disclaimer: Informational risk estimation only. Not a medical diagnosis or clinical substitute. Consult a healthcare professional.
clinical_non_diagnostic_boundary.emergency_notice: If experiencing chest pressure, pain radiating to arm/jaw, or shortness of breath, seek immediate emergency medical care.
